title: Slurm node grid - scenarios
description: Hand-written clusters that render the same way every time. Every panel carries its own CSV, so this dashboard needs no exporter, no Prometheus and no scrape to have happened.

panels.title: Every state, and the colour it gets
panels.description: Every node state in the sinfo man page, long form and abbreviation both, grouped by the raw state so the group header is the input and the cell is the output. All of them are coloured by the rules the panel ships. The last one is not a Slurm state at all: it is what a state introduced by a future Slurm looks like — drawn hollow rather than coloured, and named in the strip above, so it cannot be mistaken for a healthy node.

panels.description: Four racks of twenty; r003 has lost power. Rack layout, grouped by the rack label. The rack column in this CSV is hand-written: slurm_exporter publishes no such label, and there is nowhere for one to come from because it reads sinfo. Grouping by a label is only available if you add the label yourself, through Prometheus relabelling or a join against an inventory.

panels.title: The same rack, read without colour
panels.description: Identical data to the panel on the left with the shape channel switched on. State is carried by a notch as well as a fill, so the grid survives greyscale, print and colour-vision deficiency — where four blues and a green do not. The rack column in this CSV is hand-written: slurm_exporter publishes no such label, and there is nowhere for one to come from because it reads sinfo. Grouping by a label is only available if you add the label yourself, through Prometheus relabelling or a join against an inventory.
